cmd.description: Manage server logging: channels, filters and event categories.
cmd.dashboard: Open the logging dashboard: channels, filters and categories.
cmd.channel: Quick-set a log channel without opening the dashboard.
cmd.channelOption: The text or announcement channel for logs.
cmd.disable: Set to True to clear this log channel.
cmd.ignore: Skip logs for a channel (with its threads / a category) or members with a role.
cmd.ignoreChannel: Ignore a channel or category, or log it again (toggles).
cmd.ignoreRole: Ignore members with a role, or log them again (toggles).
cmd.ignoreList: Show the ignored channels, roles and users.

ui.categoriesHint: Pick which kinds of logs are sent
ui.filtersHint: Skip logs from specific users, channels or roles
